Senior Backend Engineer (Distributed Systems)
Postman
Remote (Work from anywhere in India)

About Postman:
Postman is the leading API platform used by over 30 million developers worldwide.

Responsibilities:
• Architect, build, and maintain highly scalable microservices powering the Postman API platform.
• Ensure low latency and high availability across distributed systems deployed on AWS.
• Work with Kafka, Docker, Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, and Redis to handle millions of requests/sec.
• Mentor junior engineers and collaborate with product managers on technical roadmaps.

Requirements:
• At least 4-6 years of software development experience building cloud-scale applications.
• Deep proficiency in Go, Python, Node.js, or Java.
• Strong expertise in distributed systems, system design, microservices, and databases.
• Work from home / Remote setup.
